scheme_name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Backward Class Students
other_conditions: Parents/guardians should not be income taxpayers
Parents/guardians should not own more than 10 acres of land
Eligibility category noted in source: Backward Class
benefits_summary: Monthly scholarship of ₹20‑₹30 for classes 6‑8 and ₹30‑₹40 for classes 9‑10, paid as a lump sum for 10 months each year.
documents_required: Hard copy of the prescribed application form
Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attest if required)
